arabic text: MUJHKO TANHA NA KABHI CHORKE JAANA BABA
MUJHKO MEHMIL ME BHALE TUM NA BITHAANA BABA
english translation text: YOU DO NOT NEED TO SEAT ME UNDER THE SHADED CANOPY

arabic text: GAR KHATAA MUJHSE HUWI HAI TO KHATAA MAAF KARO
english translation text: IF IT IS SUCH THAT I HAVE ERRED, THEN PARDON MY ERROR

arabic text: MAARDAALE NA MUJHE AAPKA JAANA BABA
english translation text: FOR IT COULD BE THAT (THE GRIEF OF) YOUR LEAVING WILL CAUSE ME TO DIE

arabic text: DEKH TAYYAAR SAKINA HAI ALI AKBER BHI
english translation text: LOOK, SAKINA AND ALI AKBER ARE READY TO GO WITH YOU

arabic text: HUN AGAR GHAIR TO TUM ITNA BATAANA BABA
english translation text: IF I AM A STRANGER TO YOU, THEN PLEASE LET ME KNOW

arabic text: TUM SE SHIKWA NA KARUNGI APNI BIMAARI KA
english translation text: NEVER AGAIN SHALL I COMPLAIN TO YOU OF MY ILLNESS

arabic text: KHUD HI LE LUNGI DAWA TUM NA PILAANA BABA
english translation text: I SHALL HAVE MY MEDICINE BY MYSELF, YOU DON'T NEED TO MAKE ME TAKE IT

arabic text: SAATH ASGHER KO LIYE JAANE KA MAQSAD KYA HAI
english translation text: WHAT'S THE REASON OF TAKING ASHGER WITH YOU

arabic text: APNI BIMAAR SE TUM YE NA CHUPAANA BABA
english translation text: DON'T HIDE THE REASON FROM YOUR UNWELL DAUGHTER

arabic text: BABA PARDES MEIN AKBER KI KARO JAB SHAADI
english translation text: FATHER! WHEN AKBER WEDS IN A FARAWAY LAND

arabic text: US GHARI SUGHRA (A.S.) KO TUM BHOOL NA JAANA BABA
english translation text: THEN AT THAT JOYOUS MOMENT, DO NOT FORGET YOUR SUGHRA

arabic text: PHIR AGAR MIL NA SAKI ITNI GUZAARISH HAI MERI
english translation text: IF WE DON'T MEET AGAIN THEN I HAVE ONE REQUEST

arabic text: MERI TURBAT PE DIYA AAKE JALAANA BABA
english translation text: PLEASE LIGHT CANDLES ON MY GRAVE

arabic text: KAARWAAN JAB YE CHALA KARBOBALA AY 'YAAWAR'
english translation text: FINALLY WHEN THE CARAVAN WAS LEAVING FOR KARBOBALA

arabic text: SUGHRA KEHTI THI YEHI LOT KE AANA BABA
english translation text: SUGHRA KEPT SAYING, PLEASE DO RETURN OH MY FATHER
